name: bear-in-mind
displayName: Bear in Mind — Copilot Token Meter
description: A polar bear's iceberg tracks Copilot plan allowance and selected-chat context. See credits, tokens, speed and quality — not a spending cap.

chatParticipants.name: iceberg
chatParticipants.description: Ask the bear about usage. Reported model-call telemetry is counted when available.

iceberg.accountUsage.enabled.markdownDescription: Allow account usage after you explicitly connect with **Iceberg: Refresh Copilot Account Usage…**. Reads your plan allowance using VS Code's GitHub sign-in and GitHub's **unofficial** `copilot_internal/user` quota API. Restore clears the saved connection; an existing GitHub grant alone does not reconnect. No local transcripts or telemetry are sent. Legacy request quotas retain their units; pooled/unlimited plans stay unscaled.

iceberg.tokenBudget.description: Optional personal visual token target used only when no usable account allowance or selected-session prompt limit is available. 0 (default) disables this fallback. Not a Copilot allowance, context limit, environmental measurement or spending cap.

iceberg.trackCopilotChat.description: Read displayed titles from VS Code's local chat-history index and reported credits from JSON/JSONL transcripts for comparison with Session Cost. Prompt/response content and token snapshots are ignored. Account quotas use the separate account-usage connection.

iceberg.otel.enabled.markdownDescription: Read the OpenTelemetry Copilot Chat emits. Run **Iceberg: Connect Copilot Telemetry…** to switch it on in Copilot Chat and point it somewhere local.

iceberg.otel.authoritative.markdownDescription: Include new telemetry usage in the reconciled meter. Off makes telemetry display-only; previously counted usage stays counted. Sources are reconciled, never summed.

iceberg.otel.feedPath.markdownDescription: Path to the JSON-lines telemetry feed. Leave empty to follow `#github.copilot.chat.otel.outfile#` (or `COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH`).

iceberg.otel.tracesDbPath.markdownDescription: Path to Copilot Chat's `agent-traces.db`. Leave empty to find it automatically.

iceberg.otel.pollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to check the telemetry feed for new records.

iceberg.chatPollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to check VS Code chat-history titles and transcript credits.

iceberg.countInputTokens.description: Count input (prompt) tokens against the budget.

iceberg.countOutputTokens.description: Count output (completion) tokens against the budget.

iceberg.statusBar.description: Show remaining ice in the status bar.

iceberg.animate.description: Animate the scene. Turn off to save CPU (the scene still renders a static frame).

iceberg.pixelScale.description: Pixel size multiplier. 0 = auto-fit to the panel.

iceberg.bearName.markdownDescription: Your bear's name. Run **Iceberg: Name the Bear…** for suggestions or enter your own.

scripts.media: node tools/make-screenshots.js && node tools/make-gif.js && node tools/make-canvas-shots.js
